name: Halfling: Lucky
effect: Append 'ro<=1' to the d20 (reroll natural 1s, keep new roll) on skill/ability/save/death-save/initiative/attack/spell-attack.
notes: character.js:8-12. Default on. Reroll modeled as reroll (not reroll-once) by the JS engine.

name: Feat: Great Weapon Master (2014)
effect: -5 to attack roll and +10 to damage.
notes: character.js:643-654. Apply-to-next-roll-only unless great-weapon-master-lock. Adds '-5' to-hit and pushes '+10' damage.

name: Feat: Great Weapon Master (2024, Heavy Weapon Mastery)
effect: Add extra damage equal to proficiency bonus (no attack penalty).

name: Feat: Sharpshooter
effect: -5 to attack roll and +10 to damage (ranged).

name: Fighting Style: Great Weapon Fighting (2014)
effect: Reroll 1s and 2s on each weapon damage die: append 'ro<=2' to each die.
condition: hasGreatWeaponFighting(2014) AND melee two-handed/versatile-2H weapon (or Polearm Master strike)
notes: utils.js:516-532, character.js:528-544. Automatic when style present.

name: Fighting Style: Great Weapon Fighting (2024)
effect: Each weapon damage die has a minimum of 3: split 'NdX' into N copies of '1dX min3'.
condition: hasGreatWeaponFighting(2024) AND melee two-handed/versatile-2H weapon (or Polearm Master strike)

name: Feat: Tavern Brawler (2024)
effect: Reroll 1s on unarmed strike / flurry of blows damage die: append 'ro<=1'.
condition: hasFeat('Tavern Brawler 2024') AND action is enhanced/unarmed strike or flurry of blows
notes: character.js:667-673. Automatic; adds 'Tavern Brawler' effect tag.

name: Feat: Flames of Phlegethos
effect: Reroll 1s on Fire damage dice: append 'ro<=1' to Fire-typed damage.
condition: hasFeat('Flames of Phlegethos') AND damage type is Fire

name: Feat: Healer - Healing Rerolls
effect: Reroll a 1 on any healing die (spell or Battle Medic).

name: Feat: Charger
effect: 2014: +5 flat damage. 2024: +1d8 damage (GWF-adjusted if applicable).

name: Feat: Piercer
effect: On a crit with piercing damage, add one extra weapon damage die (1dX) to critical damage.
condition: hasFeat('Piercer') AND critical hit AND damage type includes Piercing

name: Brutal Critical / Savage Attacks (extra crit die)
effect: On a crit, roll additional weapon dice (brutal count x highest die faces) added to critical damage.
notes: utils.js:457-483, character.js:1287-1293. Default on. Combines Brutal + Savage counts.

name: Barbarian: Brutal Strike (2024)
effect: Add 1d10 (2d10 with Improved Brutal Strike at Barbarian 17+) extra damage, GWF-adjusted.

name: Barbarian: Rage
effect: Advantage on STR checks/saves; add Rage damage (2/3/4 by level) to melee attacks.
notes: character.js:97-103, 588-593; extras.js:328-332,556-563. Sets OVERRIDE_ADVANTAGE for STR; 'Rage' effect tag.

name: Barbarian: Path of the Zealot: Divine Fury
effect: Add Divine Fury damage (1d6 + half barbarian level) to the first hit each turn while raging.

name: Barbarian: Reckless Attack
effect: Grant advantage on attack rolls (OVERRIDE_ADVANTAGE).
notes: character.js:594-598. Apply-to-next-roll unless barbarian-reckless-lock. Enables Frenzy 2024 interaction.

name: Artificer: Alchemist: Alchemical Savant
effect: Add extra damage or healing equal to Intelligence modifier (min 1) to a matching spell.

name: Artificer: Artillerist: Arcane Firearm
effect: Add 1d8 damage to Artificer spells.

name: Artificer: Battle Smith: Arcane Jolt
effect: Add 2d6 (4d6 at Artificer 15+) force/healing to weapon attacks.

name: Bard: Jack of All Trades
effect: Add half proficiency bonus to raw (non-proficient) ability checks.
notes: character.js:236-240. Default on; 'Jack of All Trades' effect tag.

name: Bard: College of Whispers: Psychic Blades
effect: Spend Bardic Inspiration to add psychic damage dice.

name: Bard: College of Spirits: Spiritual Focus
effect: Add 1d6 psychic damage or extra healing.

name: Cleric: Blessed Strikes 2024: Divine Strike
effect: Add 1d8 (2d8 with Improved Blessed Strikes) Necrotic or Radiant damage to a weapon hit.

name: Cleric: Blessed Strikes 2014 (Tasha optional)
effect: Add 1d8 (2d8 with Improved Blessed Strikes) radiant damage to a cantrip or weapon attack.

name: Cleric: Grave Domain: Circle of Mortality
effect: Maximize healing on a creature at 0 HP.

name: Cleric: Divine Strike
effect: Add 1d8 (2d8 at level 14) damage to weapon attacks.

name: Druid: Circle of Spores: Symbiotic Entity
effect: Add 1d6 necrotic damage to melee weapon strikes; also boosts Halo of Spores.

name: Druid: Circle of Wildfire: Enhanced Bond
effect: Add 1d8 to fire/healing spell damage.

name: Druid: Improved Lunar Radiance
effect: Add 2d10 radiant damage to a Wild Shape form attack.
condition: hasClassFeature('Improved Lunar Radiance') AND Wild Shape attack

name: Druid: Circle of Mutation: Circle Forms (Predator's Strike)
effect: Add +2 damage to a Beast-form attack in Wild Shape.
condition: hasClassFeature('Circle Forms') AND Wild Shape beast attack

name: Fighter: Champion: Remarkable Athlete
effect: Add half proficiency (rounded up) to STR/DEX/CON ability checks.
notes: character.js:229-234. Default on; 'Remarkable Athlete' effect tag.

name: Fighter: Rune Knight: Giant's Might
effect: Advantage on STR checks/saves; add 1d6 extra damage.

name: Monk: Diamond Soul
effect: Proficiency in all saving throws (aids death saves).

name: Paladin: Improved Divine Smite
effect: Add 1d8 radiant damage on every melee weapon hit.

name: Paladin: Radiant Strikes
effect: Add 1d8 radiant damage on melee weapon or unarmed hit.

name: Paladin: Oath of Conquest: Invincible Conqueror
effect: Crit on 19-20 (expands critical range).

name: Paladin: Oath of Devotion: Sacred Weapon
effect: Add Charisma modifier to attack rolls.

name: Ranger: Favored Foe
effect: Add extra damage die to attacks against the marked foe.

name: Ranger: Fey Wanderer: Dreadful Strikes
effect: Add 1d4 (1d6 at level 11) psychic damage.

name: Ranger: Gloom Stalker: Dread Ambusher
effect: Add 1d6/1d8/2d6/2d8 extra damage on the first-turn strike (varies by version/subfeature).

name: Ranger: Horizon Walker: Planar Warrior
effect: Convert weapon damage to force and add extra force damage die.

name: Ranger: Hunter's Prey: Colossus Slayer
effect: Add 1d8 damage to a wounded target.

name: Ranger: Monster Slayer: Slayer's Prey
effect: Add 1d6 damage to the designated prey.

name: Ranger: Natural Explorer
effect: Advantage on relevant ability checks.

name: Ranger: Swarmkeeper: Gathered Swarm
effect: Add extra force damage to attacks.

name: Rogue: Sneak Attack
effect: Add ceil(RogueLevel/2) d6 to a qualifying attack (finesse/ranged/psychic blade).
notes: character.js:1044-1055; utils.js:231-287. Default on. Lock: rogue-sneak-attack-lock; 'Sneak Attack' effect tag.

name: Rogue: Cunning Strike
effect: Spend sneak-attack dice on Cunning Strike effects (queried); reduces sneak dice.
notes: utils.js:197-266. Adds 'cunning-strike-effects' to roll info. Lock: rogue-cunning-strike-lock.

name: Rogue: Assassin: Assassinate (2014)
effect: Advantage on the attack and auto-roll critical damage dice.
notes: character.js:1333-1338, 1611-1616. OVERRIDE_ADVANTAGE + forced crit. Lock: rogue-assassinate-lock.

name: Rogue: Assassin: Assassinate (2024)
effect: Advantage on the attack and add +RogueLevel to sneak-attack damage.

name: Sorcerer: Clockwork Soul: Trance of Order
effect: Treat d20 rolls of 9 or lower as 10 (modeled as favorable roll / effect tag).

name: Warlock: Eldritch Invocation: Lifedrinker
effect: Add Charisma modifier as necrotic damage to pact weapon strikes.

name: Warlock: The Celestial: Radiant Soul
effect: Add Charisma modifier to one radiant/fire spell's damage.

name: Warlock: The Genie: Genie's Wrath
effect: Add proficiency-bonus extra damage of the genie kind's type (Dao/Djinni/Efreeti/Marid).

name: Warlock: The Hexblade: Hexblade's Curse
effect: Add proficiency-bonus damage to the cursed target AND crit on 19-20.

name: Warlock: The Undead: Grave Touched
effect: Change weapon damage to necrotic and add extra necrotic damage.

name: Wizard: Bladesinger: Bladesong
effect: Advantage on Acrobatics checks (and Song of Victory bonus damage when active).
notes: character.js:104-105, 284-303, 631-632. OVERRIDE_ADVANTAGE on Acrobatics; also warcaster/concentration interaction.

name: Wizard: Evocation Wizard: Empowered Evocation
effect: Add Intelligence modifier to one evocation spell's damage.

name: Wizard: War Magic: Durable Magic
effect: +2 to saving throws while concentrating on a spell.

name: Bloodhunter: Crimson Rite
effect: Add Crimson Rite elemental damage die to weapon attacks.

name: Aasimar: Protector: Radiant Soul
effect: Add extra radiant damage equal to character level.

name: Aasimar: Celestial Revelation: Radiant Soul (MotM)
effect: Add extra radiant damage equal to proficiency bonus.

name: Bugbear: Surprise Attack
effect: Add 2d6 damage if the target hasn't taken a turn yet in combat.

name: Fighter: Champion: Improved / Superior Critical
effect: Expand critical hit range (19-20 for Improved, 18-20 for Superior).
notes: character.js:1277-1282, 1547-1552. Automatic; sets critical-limit to 19 or 18.

name: Bard: College of Eloquence: Silver Tongue
effect: Treat Deception/Persuasion rolls of 9 or lower as 10 (favorable) - effect tag.
condition: hasClassFeature('Silver Tongue') AND skill is Deception or Persuasion

name: Rogue: Reliable Talent
effect: Treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as 10 on proficient/expertise checks (favorable min) - effect tag.
condition: hasClassFeature('Reliable Talent') AND proficiency is Proficiency or Expertise

name: Fighter: Champion: Indomitable Might
effect: Treat a STR check result lower than STR score as the STR score.
condition: hasClassFeature('Indomitable Might') AND ability is STR

name: Feature: Otherworldly Glamour
effect: Add Charisma modifier to Charisma-based ability checks.

name: Racial Tool Intuition traits (Windwright/Warder/Gifted Scribe/Healing Touch/Ever Hospitable/Artisan)
effect: Add bonus to matching tool checks.

name: Magic Item: Vicious Weapon
effect: On a natural 20 attack, add the weapon's extra flat damage as critical damage.
condition: Weapon description matches Vicious pattern AND critical hit

name: Effect: Bless
effect: Add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.

name: Effect: Bane
effect: Subtract 1d4 from attack rolls and saving throws.

name: Effect: Enlarge
effect: Advantage on STR checks/saves; +1d4 weapon damage.

name: Effect: Reduce
effect: Disadvantage on STR checks/saves; -1d4 weapon damage (min 1).

name: Effect: Exhaustion (2024)
effect: Apply -2 x exhaustion level to all d20 rolls.

name: Effect: Exhaustion (2014)
effect: Disadvantage on ability checks (level>=1) and on attacks/saves (level>=3).

name: Custom Roll dice formula bonus (d20 rolls)
effect: Append a user-defined formula to all d20 rolls (catch-all for Bless, Guidance, Bane, Magic Weapon, etc.).
notes: settings.js:503-508. Free-text; injected as CUSTOM modifier.

name: Custom Damage dice formula bonus
effect: Add user-defined dice to damage rolls; supports 'type:formula' and comma-separated independent rolls.

name: Custom magical modifier to raw ability checks
effect: Add a flat modifier (e.g. Stone of Good Luck) to raw ability checks.

name: Custom Critical limit
effect: Override the critical-hit threshold (for homebrew items).

name: Versatile weapon choice
effect: Roll versatile weapon damage as one-handed, two-handed, or both separately.
notes: settings.js:482-492. combobox both/one/two; affects GWF eligibility.

name: Toll the Dead choice
effect: Roll Toll the Dead as both damage dice separately or query which.

name: Critical hit rule (global)
effect: How crit damage is computed: PHB (roll dice twice), Homebrew Max (max value), Homebrew Reroll (reroll all), Homebrew Mod (double modifiers too), Homebrew Double.

name: Global roll mode (advantage default)
effect: Sets default advantage handling: Normal, Query, Advantage, Disadvantage, Roll Twice, Super Advantage/Disadvantage.
